elements.label: Figure 2.16
elements.description:
Two line charts (panels) showing wage trends in 2020 by household quintile, Q1 (Bottom 20) to Q5 (Top 20). Legend series: Agriculture (teal), Manufacturing (orange), Services (grey), High-skill (green), Medium-skill (cyan), Contract (1st) (purple), Low-skill (yellow). Note: Annual nominal household wage income. Source: World Bank staff calculations using VHLSS 2020.

Left panel: Y-axis 'Share of households (%)', scale 0-60 (gridlines at 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60). Approximate readings (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, Q5):
- Agriculture: ~10, ~5, ~3, ~2, ~0.5
- Manufacturing: ~41, ~48, ~47, ~39, ~25
- Services: ~16, ~24, ~30, ~37, ~46
- High-skill: ~3, ~6, ~11, ~19, ~33
- Medium-skill: ~33, ~48, ~50, ~46, ~31
- Contract (1st): ~17, ~35, ~44, ~47, ~52
- Low-skill: ~22, ~17, ~15, ~13, ~7

Right panel: Y-axis 'Annual income (millions)', scale 0-250 (gridlines at 0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250). Approximate readings (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, Q5):
- Agriculture: ~44, ~59, ~65, ~64, ~92
- Manufacturing: ~72, ~108, ~114, ~124, ~158
- Services: ~50, ~75, ~90, ~115, ~170
- High-skill: ~65, ~93, ~105, ~142, ~228
- Medium-skill: ~75, ~110, ~115, ~120, ~126
- Contract (1st): ~85, ~112, ~120, ~142, ~200
- Low-skill: ~52, ~68, ~70, ~70, ~80

Pattern: In the left panel, the share of agriculture and low-skill households falls with quintile while high-skill and services shares rise; in the right panel, incomes rise with quintile for all series, with high-skill and contract jobs showing the steepest increases at the top quintile.
